summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of redesigned /suivi page (La Capitainerie). All major features tested and working correctly across multiple viewport sizes (320px-1920px). Minor code quality issue found (duplicate data-testid).

code_quality.issue: Duplicate data-testid='chat-section' in Suivi.jsx line 1028 and ChatBox.jsx line 112
code_quality.impact: Causes strict mode violation in Playwright tests when using .is_visible() without .first

passed_tests: VISITOR flow: Header 'Ta bouteille à la mer', bottle illustration, countdown, form elements, recover block, 4 feature cards, no-code card visible
CODE LOOKUP: Valid code GP-1023-HFCD opens dossier with pseudo 'CapitaineDemo', status stamp, voyage track (data-step=3), voyage ship positioned correctly
SHORT CODE: 'HFCD' auto-completes to 'GP-1023-HFCD' and opens dossier
INVALID CODE: 'GP-1023-ZZZZ' shows error message without crash
EMPTY CODE: Shows error message when submitted empty
TAB SWITCHING: All 4 tabs (dossier, mer, taniere, etagere) switch correctly and display appropriate content
RESET BUTTON: Clears dossier and returns to empty form state
RECOVER FLOW: Power route with pseudo 'CapitaineDemo' and power '12M' successfully recovers code, recover-view-btn opens dossier
RETURNING RECRUIT: After lookup, reload automatically opens latest bottle from localStorage
DEEP LINKS: /suivi#mer, /suivi#taniere, /suivi#etagere open correct tabs
NAVBAR ROLE: Shows data-role='recruit' when recruit has active bottle
FEATURE CARDS: Clicking cards without code focuses/scrolls to code input
LANGUAGE SWITCHING: FR/EN toggle works, texts update correctly
RESPONSIVE DESIGN: Tested 320px, 375px, 390px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px - no horizontal overflow, 4-column grid tabs, sticky tablist, no overlapping texts
CHAT FUNCTIONALITY: Message input and send button work, messages appear in chat list
RACK OPERATIONS: rack-view and rack-drop buttons work, items removed from localStorage
NAVBAR REGRESSION: Logo, navigation links, suivi link all functional
HOME PAGE REGRESSION: Application form visible with all fields and submit button
COPY CODE: copy-code-btn shows 'CODE COPIÉ' after click
DISCORD CTA: Visible for accepted status with link to Discord
VOYAGE TRACK: Ship animates to correct position based on status (step 3 for accepted)
STATUS STAMP: Displays correct status with appropriate styling
BOTTLE RACK: Shows saved bottles with pseudo, code, status indicator
action_item_for_main_agent: OPTIONAL: Remove duplicate data-testid='chat-section' from either Suivi.jsx line 1028 or ChatBox.jsx line 112 to avoid strict mode violations in tests. This is a minor code quality issue and does not affect functionality.
